items.name: Acrid
items.description: The Acrid fires an acidic-infused needle.

items.name: Aegrit
items.description: What the Aegrit lacks in quantity it makes up for in destructive power. Toss the Aegrit onto your enemy’s position then detonate remotely at the right moment for maximum destructive effect.

items.name: Afuris
items.description: Furis pistols equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but Accuracy and Reload Speed are lowered.

items.name: Afuris Prime
items.description: Vanquish chaos with dual firepower.

items.name: Akarius
items.description: Bombard legions of enemies with target seeking rockets. These dual launchers reload faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. Rockets arm after reaching a safe distance.

items.name: Akarius Prime
items.description: Wield a golden pair of rocket launchers. Sprint to reload them faster. They reload fastest when wielded by Gauss.

items.name: Akbolto
items.description: A Bolto equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but reload time is doubled and accuracy is lowered.

items.name: Akbolto Prime
items.description: Gilded rails adorn these two vicious bolt launching pistols.

items.name: Akbronco
items.description: A Bronco equipped in each hand.

items.name: Akbronco Prime
items.description: Used together, these Orokin pistols feed off each other, inflicting greater damage with an enhanced status chance for inducing elemental effects on targets.

items.name: Akjagara
items.description: The design of these hard-hitting dual pistols is a mix of organic and bladed elements.

items.name: Akjagara Prime
items.description: Precision machined mirrored pistols. Primed and ready.

items.name: Aklato
items.description: A Lato equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and Fire Rate, but Reload time is doubled and Accuracy is lowered.

items.name: Aklex
items.description: Dual Lex pistols double the amount of high caliber lead you can throw at the enemy, but accuracy and reload time suffer.

items.name: Aklex Prime
items.description: Savage the enemy with a Lex Prime in each hand.

items.name: Akmagnus
items.description: Twice the ammo and twice the stopping power of a single Magnus.

items.name: Akmagnus Prime
items.description: Fill your fists with golden cannons of fury. This refined design unlocks quicker handling and higher critical chance.

items.name: Aksomati
items.description: The devastating power of the Soma rifle compacted into two elegant pistols.

items.name: Aksomati Prime
items.description: The elegant Aksomati precisely refined to this, their ultimate manifestation.

items.name: Aksondol
items.description: Narin's signature pistols strike with winter's bite. Reloading sends out a chilling pulse that inflicts Cold Status Effect, the pulse's range increases with each round reloaded.

items.name: Akstiletto
items.description: These diminutive rapid-fire Stiletto machine-pistols are just the right size to be akimbo style without sacrificing accuracy.

items.name: Akstiletto Prime
items.description: Stylish, discreet and accurate, perfect for the Tenno of distinction.

items.name: Akvasto
items.description: Vasto revolvers equipped in each hand.

items.name: Akvasto Prime
items.description: Orokin craftsmanship married with superior firepower. Dual Vastos, primed and ready to strike.

items.name: Akzani
items.description: The choice weapon of Mirage, these fast-firing dual pistols deliver a deadly performance.

items.name: Angstrum
items.description: Capable of firing multiple rockets at once, the Angstrum is a handheld instrument of destruction.

items.name: Arca Scisco
items.description: This scoped pistol analyzes strikes, learning how to damage its targets most effectively. Achieve maximum damage output after five successive hits.

items.name: Athodai
items.description: Reverse-engineered from propulsion tech this hand-cannon packs a kick. Weak Point kills trigger Overdrive, locking off secondary functions while maximizing your fire rate and giving Infinite Ammo for a short time.

items.name: Athodai Prime
items.description: Unleash the song of the righteous warrior with this gilded pistol that goes into Overdrive on Weak Point kills, maximizing fire rate and giving Infinite Ammo for a short time.

items.name: Atomos
items.description: This particle cannon generates a condensed beam of super-heated plasma designed to melt rock to ore, and enemies to molten slag.

items.name: Azima
items.description: This intricate automatic pistol is able to fire its magazine which then spins in the air for a short time, firing lasers at nearby enemies.

items.name: Ballistica
items.description: The Ballistica crossbow features a unique dual firing mechanism. Choose between a four bolt volley or a deadly accurate charged shot.

items.name: Ballistica Prime
items.description: The beauty of this luxuriously gilded crossbow cannot obscure its lethal purpose.

items.name: Bolto
items.description: The Bolto fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.

items.name: Brakk
items.description: Simple but powerful. The semi-automatic Brakk hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package.

items.name: Bronco
items.description: The Bronco is a small-scale shotgun that can be wielded with one hand. Only effective at close range, it has a limited Magazine Capacity.

items.name: Bronco Prime
items.description: Infused with rare Orokin alloys, the Bronco Prime is a highly efficient weapon, trading an increased Magazine Capacity and damage for a lower rate of fire.

items.name: Cantare
items.description:
In moments of despair, let the battle resonate with song. Cantare's blades lodge into the battlefield and return upon reload. When returning blades strike enemies, Cantare empowers allies with increased Reload Speed.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

items.name: Castanas
items.description: The remotely triggered Castanas quietly deliver a lethal dose of electricity to unsuspecting enemies.

items.name: Catabolyst
items.description: Splatter enemies with a short-range stream of corrosive bile and then toss the ammo bladder as a grenade when reloading. The emptier the pistol’s ammo bladder, the more potent its damage. A fully empty bladder packs the biggest punch.

items.name: Cestra
items.description: Compact and deadly, the Cestra discharges bolts of energy at an increasingly rapid rate.

items.name: Coda Catabolyst
items.description: When the magazine reaches empty and is manually reloaded, the Coda Catabolyst launches not one but three powerful grenades. Also has a higher Status Chance, Damage, and Magazine Size.

items.name: Coda Pox
items.description: These festering, writhing, throwable projectiles of pus and gas have been improved with a greater Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.

items.name: Coda Tysis
items.description: The Technocyte virus has contorted this Tysis into a more lethal weapon. With increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Magazine Capacity.

items.name: Cyanex
items.description: Sentient tech merges with Corpus design to deliver this lethal sidearm. Fully automatic, it fires ricocheting, homing projectiles that release small clouds of <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas on impact. Alt-fire to release the entire magazine without homing as a single burst.

items.name: Cycron
items.description: Forgo ammunition with the regenerating energy disc in this plasma throwing pistol.

items.name: Despair
items.description: Used by The Stalker, Despair throwing blades have a mono-filament edge, sharp enough to penetrate a Warframe.

items.name: Detron
items.description: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.

items.name: Dex Furis
items.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

items.name: Dual Cestra
items.description: Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.

items.name: Dual Coda Torxica
items.description: Get the job done right with a pair of spore flinging terror tools. Inflicts a spore that spreads to nearby enemies on death causing <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect and increased vulnerability to damage from the Torxica.

items.name: Dual Toxocyst
items.description: Brain-strikes excite this bioweapon, causing it to rapidly release toxic munitions.

items.name: Efv-8 Mars
items.description: The standard issue personal Efervon projector, as sported by all ranks of Scaldra.

items.name: Embolist
items.description: A living weapon, the infested Embolist pistol kills its victims with an acidic venomous gas.

items.name: Epitaph
items.description: Sevagoth's wrist-mounted sidearm fires a chilling slow-moving slab, guaranteed to slow enemies for easier marksmanship. Charge the shot to fire a punishing high-velocity, high critical chance slab that punches through barriers. Deals additional headshot damage in Sevagoth's hands.

items.name: Epitaph Prime
items.description: Send shivers down your enemies' spines with this wrist-mounted sidearm. As the signature weapon of Sevagoth Prime, it deals additional headshot damage when wielded by him.

items.name: Euphona Prime
items.description: Banshee Prime's signature shotgun is an instrument of devastation that fires both focused and broad shots.

items.name: Furis
items.description: The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.

items.name: Fusilai
items.description: Silently lacerate enemies with Gara's signature glass throwing knives. Increased Projectile Speed when wielded by Gara.

items.name: Gammacor
items.description: Designed to quickly vaporize minerals for content analysis, users discovered its powerful beam was equally efficient at dispatching hostiles.

items.name: Grimoire
items.description: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.

items.name: Grimoire
items.description: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.

items.name: Hikou
items.description: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.

items.name: Hikou Prime
items.description: As deadly as any bullet without the associated noise or commotion.

items.name: Hystrix
items.description: Heat, cold, electricity, or toxin: choose an element and launch a flurry of deadly quills. This versatile sidearm is Khora’s signature weapon and has a chance to instantly reload after headshots when she wields it.

items.name: Hystrix Prime
items.description: Versatile weapons complement deadly hunters. Khora Prime’s signature pistol rotates through hot, cold, electric, and toxic quills. When equipped on Khora, Hystrix Prime has a chance to instantly reload after headshots.

items.name: Knell
items.description: Ring the death knell. Headshots briefly turn this scoped pistol into a rapid-fire, Critical Damage fiend that uses no ammo. When used by Harrow, Knell has a 2-round mag.

items.name: Knell Prime
items.description: Ring a funeral toll upon enemy skulls with Harrow Prime's signature pistol.

items.name: Kohmak
items.description: Like the larger Kohm, this hand-shotgun doubles its volley with each successive shot.

items.name: Kompressa
items.description: Launch a volley of virulent, hyper-pressurized, water globules that envelope targets and explode with torrential force. Yareli's signature pistol.

items.name: Kompressa Prime
items.description: Glinting like a golden dawn, Yareli Prime’s signature pistol engulfs foes in a cascade of virulent, explosive, water globules. None can escape the sea.

items.name: Kraken
items.description: The Kraken is a heavy pistol of Grineer design that fires two quick shots with a single pull of the trigger. Skilled marksmen will appreciate the value in this deadly accurate weapon.

items.name: Kulstar
items.description: Rain hell on the enemy with this handheld cluster-rocket launcher.

items.name: Kunai
items.description: Kunai throwing daggers offer a silent alternative to the traditional side arm. Perfect for assassins.

items.name: Kuva Brakk
items.description: This Lich-variant semi-automatic hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package. Higher fire rate, magazine capacity and reload speed.

items.name: Kuva Kraken
items.description: A custom variant that fires three quick shots with a single pull of the trigger, or can alt-fire burst the remainder of its magazine. Higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed.

items.name: Kuva Nukor
items.description: A highly-optimized Nukor that allows for the weapon’s microwave field to hit up to two additional targets.

items.name: Kuva Seer
items.description: This variant pistol has higher fire rate and magazine capacity. Superior zoom capabilities plus projectiles have a small Corrosive burst.

items.name: Kuva Twin Stubbas
items.description: Double-fist rapid-fire bursts of pain with these dual-wield variants of the Grineer submachine gun. Higher Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity.

items.name: Laetum
items.description: During parades and victory marches, the Laetum fired pigmented airburst rounds that rained onto festive crowds. The Orokin sent Laetum with the Zariman so they could properly celebrate a successful maiden voyage to Tau. There would be no such celebration, but the Void imbued the Laetum with a much more explosive capacity.

items.name: Lato
items.description: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.

items.name: Lato Prime
items.description: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.

items.name: Lato Vandal
items.description: A special version of the standard Lato pistol with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher Accuracy and Damage values. The Lato Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.

items.name: Lex
items.description: The Lex is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.

items.name: Lex Prime
items.description: The Lex Prime is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.

items.name: Magnus
items.description: The versatile Magnus revolver is a lethal sidearm for any Tenno.

items.name: Magnus Prime
items.description: Orokin elegance meets formidable stopping power in this exquisite revolver. Hits have a chance to give Infinite Ammo for a few seconds.

items.name: Mara Detron
items.description: For Orokin-era smugglers, this fearsome handheld shotgun was a favored tool for 'dispute resolution'.

items.name: Marelok
items.description: The Marelok combines the stopping power of a rifle with the portability of a pistol.

items.name: Mk1-Furis
items.description: The MK1-Furis are the standard issue automatic pistol for all Tenno.

items.name: Mk1-Kunai
items.description: The MK1-Kunai is the standard issue throwing knives for all Tenno.

items.name: Nukor
items.description: Creates and focuses a high-frequency field of microwaves, literally cooking the target from within.

items.name: Ocucor
items.description: A weapon that reaches for its next victim even as it kills. With each takedown, this pistol spawns an energy tendril that reaches for a nearby target.

items.name: Onos
items.description: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this weapon. In Incarnon form, draw in ambient power to deal steadily increased damage to enemies. At full power, release a blast of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.

items.name: Pandero
items.description: Octavia's pistol hammers foes with single shots or a rapid volley of bullets. When wielded by Octavia, alt-fire Headshot Kills increase Reload Speed.

items.name: Pandero Prime
items.description: Pound the beat for a dance of death with Octavia's signature prime pistol.

items.name: Plinx
items.description: Cultivate a meaningful relationship with this deceptively simple battery-powered pistol. The Plinx rewards attention and investment from the wise.

items.name: Pox
items.description: These festering sacs of pus and gas burst violently on impact.

items.name: Prisma Angstrum
items.description: Imbued with the finest Prisma crystal, this refined Angstrum features boosted charge and reload speeds.

items.name: Prisma Twin Gremlins
items.description: Fused with prisma crystals, these pristine Grineer sidearms are sure to intimidate any foe.

items.name: Pyrana
items.description: Chew through the enemy with this vicious automatic hand shotgun.

items.name: Pyrana Prime
items.description: Three kills in rapid succession to summon a second ethereal Pyrana for twice the deadly punch.

items.name: Quatz
items.description: A compact four-barreled design packing a self-charging capacitor that discharges upon every reload from empty. Features auto hip-fire and aimed fire is semi-auto, four-shot instant burst.

items.name: Rakta Ballistica
items.description: This modified ballistica is the weapon of choice used by Red Veil Assassins to take out high-priority marks.

items.name: Riot-848
items.description: Never stop fighting, never run out of ammo. Temple's signature machine pistol was modified by Albrecht Entrati to warp fired bullets back into the magazine when reloaded.

items.name: Sagek Prime
items.description: The sidearm of choice for Prime Grineer warriors, Sagek Prime blends Grineer brutality with Orokin aesthetics. When Sagek Prime inflicts a critical hit, its next shot has a chance to gain significant Status Chance.

items.name: Sancti Castanas
items.description: This remotely detonated electrical trap is used by devotees of New Loka to protect their temples and shrines.

items.name: Scyotid
items.description: Go on the hunt with Oraxia’s signature secondary. Fling a volley of toxin-laced barbs, or drop a cluster snare that scatters on impact, seizing nearby enemies and dragging them together.

items.name: Secura Dual Cestra
items.description: The favored side-arms of Perrin Sequence executives, these pistols have been modified to improve efficiency and killing potential.

items.name: Seer
items.description: Captain Vor's prized Orokin-Grineer hybrid pistol has an average rate of fire, but it has high damage and superior zoom capabilities.

items.name: Sepulcrum
items.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. This large, weighty double-barreled pistol delivers twin projectiles that pack a punch, exploding on impact. Secondary fire puts the weapon in lock-on mode. Aim to lock onto multiple targets, then fire to unleash homing projectiles.

items.name: Sicarus
items.description: The Sicarus fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.

items.name: Sicarus Prime
items.description: The Sicarus Prime is an ornamental firearm that fires rounds in rapid bursts, providing a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.

items.name: Sonicor
items.description: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.

items.name: Spectra
items.description: While its intended design is for deep space construction, the concentrated laser beam of the Spectra is highly effective against organic and synthetic enemies.

items.name: Spectra Vandal
items.description: A special-order Corpus cutting tool for master crafters only. Features distinctive azurite plating and a focusing crystal of precision clarity and cut.

items.name: Spira
items.description: A flash of red ribbon is the last thing most victims of these throwing-daggers see.

items.name: Spira Prime
items.description: These rare, braided throwing daggers were a favorite tool of high ranking Orokin assassins.

items.name: Staticor
items.description: Send a massive charge of potential energy hurling toward unfortunate targets.

items.name: Stubba
items.description: Inflict rapid-fire bursts of pain with this Grineer submachine gun.

items.name: Stug
items.description: Firing a sticky, toxic, explosive compound, the Stug Gel Gun offers multiple ejection modes, delivering maximum damage in all situations.

items.name: Synoid Gammacor
items.description: Deployed by the Cephalon Suda, once a data-analyzing instrument the Gammacor main focus is defense.

items.name: Talons
items.description: The claws of these tactical bombs dig into the target and detonate on command.

items.name: Telos Akbolto
items.description: For the Arbiters of Hexis these pistols are more than simple weapons, they are symbols of truth and discipline.

items.name: Tenet Cycron
items.description: This reengineered Cycron features a refracting energy disc that can split off the main target, hitting up to 2 additional nearby targets.

items.name: Tenet Detron
items.description: Parvos Granum's engineers have made this already ferocious hand cannon even more deadly with the addition of an alternate fire mode that empties an entire clip in one devastating burst.

items.name: Tenet Diplos
items.description: Itemize and execute with this pair of auto-lock-on, homing-projectile pistols. Shoot from-hip for a more conventional pistol experience. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the pistols when holstered.

items.name: Tenet Plinx
items.description: Alternate fire on this reengineered Plinx fires a projectile that pulls enemies close and then explodes. Its cooldown increases after the explosion to accommodate battery power demands.

items.name: Tenet Spirex
items.description: Dominate rivals with this pistol’s lightning fast rail-slugs. Head-shots speed up reload.

items.name: Twin Grakatas
items.description: When one Grakata isn't enough, bring another for extra firepower.

items.name: Twin Gremlins
items.description: Designed as a pair, these Grineer sidearms fire projectiles at a slower rate but with greater force and accuracy.

items.name: Twin Kohmak
items.description: Doubling their volley on each successive shot, the Twin Kohmaks decimate foes in seconds.

items.name: Twin Rogga
items.description: These twin barrels of destruction are the signature pistols of the Kuva Guardians.

items.name: Twin Vipers
items.description: A Viper equipped in each hand.

items.name: Twin Vipers Wraith
items.description: The uniquely styled Twin Vipers Wraith are a powerful variation on the standard akimbo machine-pistols.

items.name: Tysis
items.description: The Tysis pistol spits out caustic darts that corrode their victims from within.

items.name: Vasto
items.description: Steady and reliable, the Vasto revolver combines speed and power for a classic gunslinger feel.

items.name: Vasto Prime
items.description: This elegant rapid-fire revolver is the embodiment of superior Orokin craftsmanship.

items.name: Vaykor Marelok
items.description: Taken from defeated Grineer commanders and rebuilt to improve combat efficiency and reliability.

items.name: Velox
items.description: With a high fire rate, ammo efficiency and rapid reload when emptied, this unusual sidearm can hand out carnage all day long. Ammo efficiency is further increased when Protea uses this, her signature weapon.

items.name: Velox Prime
items.description: This sidearm’s circular design evokes Protea Prime’s perception of time.

items.name: Vesper 77
items.description: A true masterpiece of Höllvanian engineering, Vesper 77's advanced laser sight highlights enemy Weak Points with precision. Aim to increase its Critical Damage Multiplier.

items.name: Viper
items.description: A full-auto pistol known as the most compact and lightweight weapon of the Grineer arsenal. Though it has a small Magazine Capacity, the Viper has a very high Fire Rate and ultra-fast reload times thanks to a simplified magazine design.

items.name: Viper Wraith
items.description: The uniquely styled Viper Wraith is a powerful variation on the standard machine-pistol.

items.name: Zakti
items.description: Fires razor-sharp darts that anchor themselves in their target before erupting in a plume of toxic gas.

items.name: Zakti Prime
items.description: A thousand pains, before their end.

items.name: Zylok
items.description: Hammer the enemy with this light-bodied heavy hitter. Featuring a double-action trigger that fires hard and fast.

items.name: Zylok Prime
items.description: A lightweight weapon that packs a punch worthy of its golden design.

items.name: Zymos
items.description: Infect your foes with this spore-scattering pistol. Headshots burrow in and explode, releasing spore clouds that seek out nearby enemies.
